name: Mocking God
overview: Scripture reveals that mocking God stems from a heart of foolishness and rebellion, as seen in Psalms where the scornful and the fool deny God's existence and righteousness. This attitude leads to corruption and abominable deeds, contrasting with the blessedness of those who avoid ungodly counsel and scorn. Even as believers face reviling and false accusations for Christ's sake, salvation is found only in the name of Jesus, underscoring the seriousness of honoring God rather than mocking Him.
